formulations.Polymer system Notes: Aliphatic polysulfite obtained by ionic copolymerization of SO2 with ethylene oxide at room temperature (ref. [9] in paper). Undoped copolymer amorphous; addition of Li salt induces a crystalline complex (see LiClO4 entry).

formulations.Reference: Przyłuski, J.; Wieczorek, W. Copolymer electrolytes. Solid State Ionics 53-56 (1992) 1071-1076.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Aliphatic polysulfite obtained by ionic copolymerization of SO2 with ethylene oxide at room temperature (ref. [9] in paper). Undoped copolymer amorphous; Li salt addition induces a crystalline complex (Fig.6 DSC).
formulations.Tm: ~39°C minor peak (residual EO crystallites); ~109°C major peak (crystalline EO-SO2-LiClO4 complex, ΔHm=77.9 J/g) — read from Fig.6 DSC curve
formulations.Notes: LiClO4 = 10 mol% rel. copolymer monomeric units. Conductivity read from Fig.5 digitized plot ("x" series), cross-checked against figure's own °C axis. High ΔHm of the 109°C peak (Fig.6) suggests strong complexation power of EO-SO2 host; system reported unstable over time, stabilized in prior work by blending with PEO (ref [9]).
